section: Shot 3 camera solve (f304-452): CL medium shot. Result: a locked-off ~235 mm telephoto from the balcony vantage at the end of shot 2, about 8.5 m from CL and pitched 28.7 deg down, with no handheld roll. Work files are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-tmi2022/15258eef-8986-57e2-bae2-19a7d6419b6e/scratchpad/s3cam/: spec_fragment_shot3.json, anchor_checks.json, cam_static.json, overlay.jpg, and the solve/track scripts solve2-5.py, bgtrack.py, bgtrack2.py, final_cam.py, make_fragment.py.

measurements.name: shot3 camera roll (absolute and animated)
measurements.value: 0 (background roll stays within +-0.4 deg over f304-452)
measurements.method: Masked CL (bright, orange or white pixels, closed and dilated), gamma + CLAHE on the background, then KLT with a forward-backward check and a RANSAC similarity per frame pair (118 unique pairs, 30-560 inliers each). Per-pair rotation std 0.025 deg; top and side regions agree to f380. Mediapipe eye-line angle does not follow the ORB 'roll' (corr 0.06); hip line corr 0.28. So the +5/-5 deg ORB rotation is CL's hip sway, not the camera.

measurements.name: shot3 camera pan/tilt/zoom drift
measurements.value: static: drift under 25 px, scale 1.00-1.03 (ambiguous +2% step near f381-393: side regions say +2.4%, top region says -2.4%, so it is likely background content morphing)
measurements.method: Same background KLT chain, split into whole-frame / top band / sides

measurements.name: shot3 lens
measurements.method: At the chosen 8.50 m distance, lens = 1474 px/m x 8.50 m x 36/1920. 1474 px/m is the geometric-mean compromise between the head cue (hair-top to chin 375 px for 0.24 m, about 1560-1740 px/m) and body-width cues (mediapipe shoulders 367 px for 0.28-0.30 m, corset waist 275 px for 0.20-0.22 m, about 1250-1375 px/m). The 0.17 m face-box prior alone would give about 290 mm.

measurements.name: shot3 camera-to-CL-face distance
measurements.method: Least-squares family solve on: face centre at (566,491); crowd row on the pit floor 2.2-3.5 m behind CL with frame-top crossing at z~1.05 m (hanging hand in f304 spans y 200-360); crowd floor contact y~950-1100 (gamma-boosted row profiles); crowd scale 1000-1330 px/m (wrist 80 px, palm 115 px, hand length 160 px); front-row heads kept below frame. Distance and lens trade off along the viewing ray. Picked the solution that coincides with the shot-2 BA end camera (s2cam ba4 f303 C=(-0.3,-7.58,5.64), pitch 28.2).

measurements.name: shot3 camera height
measurements.value: 5.55 world (3.80 above CL face, 5.25 above stage top)
measurements.method: Same family solve; elevation to the face is 26.5 deg

measurements.name: shot3 camera downward tilt (optical axis pitch)
measurements.method: Background geometry (forearms at frame top, crowd feet at y~1000, crowd 1.3-1.6x smaller than CL) plus clearing front-row heads off the bottom of frame. Horizon at y = -5900 px, far above the frame. Cross-check: corset top edge is nearly straight (sag under 8 px over 115-125 px half-width), consistent with ~29 deg minus CL's 10-15 deg forward lean. A lower camera (~20 deg) would put front-row heads over her skirt and raise crowd feet to y~1430.

measurements.name: CL face centre in image (shot 3)
measurements.value: mean (565.5, 491.4), std (7.3, 11.7); slow upward drift of ~40 px across the shot
measurements.method: Centres of the 25 shot3_CL_face lbpcascade boxes

measurements.name: face box width vs model
measurements.value: measured 317 mean, projected 251 for a 0.17 m box
measurements.method: The anime head is drawn about 26% larger relative to the body than MMD proportions. The lens compromise keeps the body (shoulders y688, waist y1046, palms y1381, knees y1741) close to the drawn figure (palms ~1300, knees ~1800-1900).

measurements.name: background crowd row distance behind CL
measurements.method: Projection through the chosen camera: row at Y=+2.4 gives frame-top z=1.03, feet y=1032 and scale 1130 px/m, all matching the measured cues

measurements.name: stage disc back edge in shot 3
measurements.method: Projected r=1.6, z=0.3 circle; matches where the blue glossy floor with sparkle reflections starts behind CL (y~1100-1250)

measurements.name: DOF f-stop
measurements.method: Background hand edge 10-90% width is about 4 px (f304 row profiles). Blur at the crowd 2.6 m behind is about 83.5/N px for 235 mm focused at 8.5 m, so N of 11-16 gives 5-8 px.

open_issues: The task's 'handheld roll +5 -> -8 -> +3 deg' does not hold up. Those numbers are ORB global motion dominated by CL's dress, i.e. her hip sway. Background-only tracking shows the camera fixed (roll under 0.4 deg). CAM_Shot3 is therefore static, and the face-anchor residuals (mean 11.7 px, max 25.4 px, rms 13.9 px) are CL's own head bob, which the MMD motion must reproduce. If the integrator still wants a handheld feel, keep roll noise at or below 0.3 deg.

Distance and lens are degenerate along the viewing ray: 5.5 m/165 mm to 9.2 m/240 mm all fit the background cues. I tied CAM_Shot3 to the in-progress shot-2 bundle-adjust end camera (s2cam/ba4_out f303: C=(-0.3,-7.58,5.64), pitch 28.2). If that solve or the balcony moves, re-place CAM_Shot3 per the note (lens = 1474 px/m x distance x 36/1920, face at (566,491)).

Head-vs-body scale conflict. The AI-drawn CL head is about 26% larger relative to her body than MMD proportions. 235 mm is a compromise: about 275 mm matches the drawn head (then palms land ~1530 and knees fall below frame); about 210 mm matches body widths. The 0.17 m face-box prior alone implies ~290 mm. Choose based on the user's actual MMD model.
Possible +2% push-in near f381-396 (side regions +2.4%, top region -2.4%; face boxes are ~5% larger in the second half). It is not keyed. If wanted, ramp lens 235 -> 240 over f380-f396.

Front-of-stage crowd occlusion. Heads at z 1.6-1.9 inside x -0.6..0.5, y -2.35..-1.3 would appear over CL's skirt at the bottom of frame. The crowd zone owner should exclude [-0.05,-1.8,0.55] or start the -Y crowd beyond r ~2.3 in that wedge.

Shot 3 shows the stage disc top behind CL (y>1180) as dark glossy blue with sparkle reflections, not the bright white spot pool seen in shot 2. Per-shot lighting cheat: the stage spot is off or narrowed in shot 3, and the stage-top material should read dark and reflective without the spot.
Stage-top height 0.3 m is taken from the provisional test_spec. If the stage owner changes it, shift the camera z and target z by the same amount (CL location z follows the stage top).

Absolute roll could not be measured independently: there are no reliable world verticals in the dark, AI-morphing background, and LSD line angles are noisy. 0 deg is assumed, and CL's mean upright posture is consistent with it.

The background crowd is AI-regenerated within the shot (people appear and disappear around f381-393), so crowd-based scale and position cues carry ~20% uncertainty. Long-baseline matching (f304 vs f350+) fails for the same reason.
